concerns.text: SC-001 requires that cross‑validated R² performance be measured against a null (mean‑predictor) baseline on the held‑out test set. Task T009’s description only mentions computing bootstrap confidence intervals for R² and RMSE, and a paired t‑test between models, but does not specify generating or reporting the null‑baseline R² for comparison. This omission means the success criterion cannot be verified, constituting a weakening of the specification.
